blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Five major stations of the Metro Rail Transit Line 3 (MRT-3) are targeted for rehabilitation and modernization by next year, Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said on Friday. The Department of Transportation (DOTr) is eyeing the rehabilitation of four to five stations before the end of President Marcos’ term of office. The included stations are GMA-Kamuning, North Avenue, Cubao and Shaw Boulevard, with Taft Station also being considered for inclusion in the project. Dizon described these as the “biggest stations in the system,” which serve a significant number of the around 500,000 commuters who use the MRT-3 daily. […]...
